claim: World snapshots, action logs, state transitions and evaluator results reproduce according to their declared determinism guarantees.
caveats: Guarantees: replay of recorded events is exact always; regeneration is exact because outcomes the kernel cannot recompute (program outputs, measured CPU) are recorded; fork-versus-parent equality and cross-process equality hold under the deterministic cost model only. With measured CPU cost, two fresh executions of the same world differ. A handler that keeps state in process memory can still cost more on a fresh sandbox worker.
